title: Jio shares surge 21% in market debut after blockbuster India IPO
summary: Jio has debuted as India's second-most valuable listed company, behind its parent, Reliance Industries.
llm_summary: Jio’s shares jumped about 21% on their first day of trading, catapulting the telecom giant to become India’s second‑largest listed company, trailing only its parent, Reliance Industries. The strong debut underscores the market’s confidence in Jio’s growth
